info.name: pdf-shop-worker
info.description:
Simulates a GCP Pub/Sub push notification for a Cloud Storage document-created event, so worker's POST / can be triggered manually during local testing without real GCP infrastructure.

Before sending: run `nx serve pdf-shop-worker`, create a document via the website's /create page, and set the `documentId` variable below to the id from that document's created.json (visible in the /payment URL after creating a spec). The request's `message.data` field is included only for structural realism — worker's current handler reads just `message.attributes.eventType` and `message.attributes.objectId`, so `data` does not need to stay in sync with `documentId`.
